meta.description: Set up AI Runway on AKS — from bare cluster to running model. Covers cluster verification, controller install, GPU assessment, provider setup, and first deployment. howto.when: 当你说出“setup AI Runway”、“install AI Runway”、“run LLM on AKS”等类似请求时触发。
